pages.privacy_policy.sections.changes_po: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the \"Last updated\" date. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.
pages.privacy_policy.sections.children_p: Our Service is not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18. If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child under 18, we will delete such information.
pages.privacy_policy.sections.contact.in: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
pages.privacy_policy.sections.data_reten: We retain your information for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy:
Account information: Until you delete your account
Advertising data: For the duration of your subscription plus 2 years for analytics
Legal compliance: As required by applicable laws
Usage data: Up to 3 years for service improvement
pages.privacy_policy.sections.data_secur: However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information:
Encryption of data in transit and at rest
Multi-tenant architecture with complete data isolation
Monitoring and logging of system activities
pages.privacy_policy.sections.how_we_use: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
Detect, prevent, and address technical issues
Improve our Service and develop new features
Process transactions and send related information
Provide, operate, and maintain our Service
Respond to comments, questions, and customer service requests
pages.privacy_policy.sections.informatio: When you connect your advertising accounts (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads), we collect:
Campaign performance metrics (impressions, clicks, conversions, spend)
We may automatically collect certain information about your device and usage:
Log information (IP address, browser type, operating system)
Usage data (features used, time spent, clicks)
We may collect personally identifiable information that you voluntarily provide to us, including:
Billing information (processed securely by third-party payment processors)
Name and email address (for account registration)
We may share aggregated, anonymized data for industry benchmarking purposes. This data cannot be used to identify individual users or accounts.
We may share your information in the following circumstances:
We may disclose your information if required by law or in response to valid legal requests.
We may share your information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf:
Cloud hosting providers (for data storage and processing)
pages.privacy_policy.sections.internatio: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your information in accordance with this Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws.
pages.privacy_policy.sections.introducti: ("we," "our," or "us") operates the advertising intelligence and benchmarking platform (the "Service"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our advertising intelligence and benchmarking platform.
By accessing or using our Service, you agree to this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, please do not access the Service.
pages.privacy_policy.sections.third_part: Our Service may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.
pages.privacy_policy.sections.your_right: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.
Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
Access: Request access to your personal information
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate information
Deletion: Request deletion of your personal information
Objection: Object to processing of your personal information
Portability: Request a copy of your data in a portable format
Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
